info.title: Cascadehook project API
info.description: Project API for application integration after human signup, organization and project creation. Authenticate with the selected project API key; compare GET /v1/project-status project_id before mutations. The WEB origin hosting this document can differ from the API server origin. Project API keys have broad project access; dev/live labels have identical permissions. All JSON request bodies require application/json. Management JSON bodies are capped at 64 KiB; event bodies at 256 KiB. Errors are application/problem+json. Observe Retry-After, use bounded retries, and inspect state after uncertain mutations. A 202 receipt never confirms delivery. See /docs/agents.md on this document host for the full workflow and receiver protocol.

post.summary: Provision or rotate a signing secret

200.description: One-time secret. Capture directly to the receiver environment; never print this response.

post.description: EMPTY BODY required: do not send {}. Also rotates an existing secret; ask for explicit approval before rotation. Not idempotent. Previous secret has a five-minute grace period; overlapping rotation returns 409 signing_secret_rotation_in_progress. Does not disable an already active endpoint or clear verified_at. Inspect state after a lost response.

post.summary: Verify receiver ownership with a signed challenge

200.description: Verified endpoint. Delivery is not automatically enabled.

post.description: EMPTY BODY required: do not send {}. Install the current secret on a running public HTTPS receiver first. Receiver must verify the raw signed request and return exactly {"proof":"<base64 HMAC-SHA256>"}, using message cascadehook.verify.v1.<Webhook-Id>.<data.challenge>. One attempt per 30 seconds; respect Retry-After. Plain empty 200 is insufficient. Errors include endpoint_verification_failed (502), invalid_verification_proof (422), unsafe_endpoint_destination (422), endpoint_verification_rate_limited (429), and endpoint_verification_changed (409).

Only succeeded/failed deliveries with a ready endpoint can be replayed. expected_cycle is the current delivery cycle. Same delivery/from-cycle returns its first receipt; stale cycle conflicts. Preserves Webhook-Id, so receiver deduplication may skip business work.

projectAPIKey.bearerFormat: ch_dev_ or ch_live_ project API key
projectAPIKey.description: Read CASCADEHOOK_API_KEY from the local environment. Never print keys or headers. Scope is the project selected when the key was created.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page; omit on the first page. Keep filters unchanged.

idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKey.description: One key per logical event. Reuse with the EXACT serialized bytes on retry, within 24 hours. Whitespace changes also cause idempotency_conflict.

Problem.description: Non-success response. Inspect code: invalid_api_key (401); project_suspended (403); resource not found (404); quota_exceeded, idempotency_conflict or readiness/version conflicts (409); validation failures (400/422); request_too_large (413); unsupported_media_type (415); project/global/verification rate limits (429); endpoint_verification_failed (502); request_timeout, request_controls_unavailable or authentication_unavailable (503); internal_error (500). Retry-After is present on rate-limited responses.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when supplied.

url.description: HTTPS, no credentials/fragment. Maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Public destination required at verification/delivery; redirects are rejected.

UpdateEndpoint.description: Only supplied fields change; null is rejected. URL changes clear verification and disable delivery. Enabling requires a signing secret and verified ownership. event_types replaces the subscription list.

signing_secret.description: One-time credential. Capture directly to the receiver environment; never print or log it.

PublishEvent.description: Exactly type and data; duplicate envelope keys are rejected. Entire serialized body maximum 262144 bytes. Retries must preserve exact bytes and Idempotency-Key.

expires_at.description: Optional future expiry; null or omitted means no expiry.

payload.description: Complete original event envelope, containing type and data; not just data.
